items.quote: after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died
items.claim: Aaron's two sons died when they offered before the LORD

items.quote: Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not
items.claim: The LORD commanded Aaron not to enter the holy place at all times
items.object: the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat
items.place: the holy place; the vail; the mercy seat; the ark

items.quote: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat
items.claim: The LORD will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat
